title: Quality Analyst (QA)
description:
**Job Description – Quality Analyst (QA)**

**Company:** Delhi Eduskills  
**Position:** Quality Analyst  
**Experience:** Minimum 1+ Years  
**Job Location:** D-44, Sector 59, Noida  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

Delhi Eduskills is looking for a detail-oriented and result-driven Quality Analyst with at least 1 year of experience in quality monitoring and process improvement.

The candidate will be responsible for monitoring the quality of student interactions, counselling processes, admission-related activities, and overall operational performance. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and experience in maintaining quality standards within the education, EdTech, or skill development industry.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Quality Monitoring & Auditing**
* Monitor and evaluate calls handled by the counselling, admission, and student support teams.
* Conduct regular quality audits of calls, emails, and other student interactions.
* Ensure employees follow the defined communication standards, scripts, and company processes.
* Identify gaps in communication, process adherence, and customer handling.
* **Feedback & Performance Improvement**
* Provide constructive feedback to employees based on quality evaluations.
* Conduct regular feedback sessions and coaching to improve individual performance.
* Identify recurring errors and recommend corrective actions.
* Work closely with team leaders and managers to improve overall team quality.
* **Process Compliance**
* Ensure proper communication of course details, fee structures, program information, and admission procedures.
* Monitor adherence to company policies, SOPs, and operational guidelines.
* Ensure accurate and transparent information is shared with students and prospective learners.
* Identify process deviations and report them to the concerned management.
* **Reporting & Analysis**
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly quality reports.
* Maintain quality scorecards and audit records.
* Analyse quality trends, employee performance, and recurring process gaps.
* Share quality insights and improvement recommendations with management.
* **Training & Development**
* Conduct quality calibration sessions with team leaders and employees.
* Assist in onboarding and training new employees on quality standards.
* Conduct refresher training sessions wherever required.
* Help improve student experience and service delivery through continuous quality enhancement.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 1+ years of experience as a Quality Analyst, preferably in EdTech, Education, or Skill Development.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Good understanding of call auditing, quality parameters, and performance evaluation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting tools.
* Ability to identify performance gaps and provide actionable feedback.
* Good interpersonal skills with the ability to coordinate with different teams.
* Knowledge of CRM systems and LMS platforms will be an added advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Call quality scores and audit accuracy.
* Process and SOP adherence.
* Reduction in quality errors and deviations.
* Improvement in employee quality performance.
* Timely completion of quality audits and reports.
* Overall student interaction and service quality.

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.**

title: Sr. Test Engineer
description:
Job Description – Senior Software Tester

Job Title: Senior Software Tester / Senior QA Engineer  
Experience: 7–10+ years

Job location- NCR  
Job Type: Full-time  
Department: Quality Assurance / Software Testing

1. Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Tester Senior Tester with hands-on testing expertise, client-facing responsibilities, and team management capabilities. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in test planning, test design, test execution, defect management, and automation framework development, along with the ability to coordinate testing activities across cross-functional teams.

The candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ownership of testing deliverables, and the ability to work effectively in an Agile environment while contributing to continuous improvement in QA processes.

2. Key Responsibilities

Test Planning and Execution

* Analyse business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories to identify test scenarios and testing scope.
* Prepare and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and traceability matrices.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.
* Execute smoke, sanity, and release validation testing across different environments.
* Identify gaps in requirements and collaborate with Business Analysts, developers, and stakeholders to clarify expectations.
* Demonstrate strong client-handling skills, including regular communication with clients, understanding business expectations, providing testing updates, addressing concerns, and managing expectations effectively.
* Manage and coordinate the testing team, including task allocation, workload prioritisation, progress monitoring, review of testing deliverables, and ensuring timely completion of assigned activities.
* Proactively identify and communicate testing risks, dependencies, blockers, and potential delivery impacts to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, effectively prioritising testing activities, allocating time and resources, and meeting project milestones and deadlines without compromising quality.
* Ensure adequate test coverage and quality standards are maintained throughout the software development lifecycle.

Automation Testing

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using frameworks and tools such as Selenium, or Playwright.
* Identify suitable test cases for automation and contribute to automation strategy and framework improvements.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing.
* Analyse automation failures, troubleshoot issues, and distinguish between application defects, script failures, and environment-related issues.
* Maintain reusable automation components and ensure scripts remain reliable, scalable, and maintainable.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve testing efficiency through automation and AI-assisted testing tools.

Defect Management

* Identify, document, prioritise, and track defects throughout the defect lifecycle.
* Work closely with developers and business stakeholders to investigate issues and validate fixes.
* Perform retesting and regression testing to ensure defects are resolved without introducing new issues.
* Provide clear defect reports with reproduction steps, test evidence, expected results, and actual results.
* Monitor defect trends and communicate quality risks, blockers, and dependencies proactively.

Team Coordination and Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate testing activities across team members, projects, and multiple applications.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, developers, product owners, SMEs, and business users.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide regular updates on testing progress, execution status, defects, risks, and release readiness.
* Support UAT activities and coordinate with business users to validate business requirements.
* Mentor junior testers, review test cases and automation scripts, and share testing best practices.
* Take ownership of assigned testing deliverables and ensure timely completion of testing activities.

Reporting and Continuous Improvement

* Prepare test execution reports, defect summaries, test completion reports, and quality dashboards.
* Maintain testing artefacts and evidence in test management and project tracking tools.
* Identify process improvements to enhance test coverage, productivity, and release quality.
* Contribute to risk-based testing, test estimation, resource planning, and continuous QA improvement initiatives.
* Support production releases through smoke testing, sanity checks, and post-deployment validation.

3. Required Technical Skills

* Manual Testing: Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.
* Automation Testing: Hands-on experience Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent automation tools.
* Test Management: Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar test management and defect tracking tools.
* API Testing: Knowledge of REST APIs, request/response validation, and tools such as Postman.
* Database Testing: Ability to write SQL queries and validate backend data.
* CI/CD: Understanding of automated test execution within build and deployment pipelines.
* Methodologies: Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, and Scrum practices.
* Documentation: Ability to create and maintain test plans, test cases, test reports, and traceability documentation.
* Version Control: Familiarity with Git or equivalent version control tools.

4. Required Experience and Competencies

* 7–10+ years of experience in software testing, including both manual and automation testing.
* Proven experience testing enterprise web-based applications.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams and managing testing activities across multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and deadlines effectively.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
* Experience mentoring team members and supporting knowledge transfer.

5. Desirable Skills

* Experience in telecom, asset management, waste management, hospitality, or other enterprise business domains.
* Exposure to mobile application testing on Android and iOS.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter.
* Familiarity with cloud-based applications and enterprise integrations.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted testing, generative AI, AI agent validation, and intelligent test automation.
* Exposure to Business Analysis activities, including requirement reviews, process understanding, and acceptance criteria validation.

6. Key Success Criteria

The Senior Software Tester will be expected to:

* Deliver comprehensive test coverage aligned with business requirements.
* Identify critical defects early and minimise production issues.
* Maintain reliable and effective automation suites.
* Provide transparent and timely reporting on testing progress and quality risks.
* Coordinate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement in testing practices and team capability.
* Support high-quality, predictable, and timely software releases.

Job Description: QA Tester – FinTech

**Job Title:** QA Tester / Quality Assurance Engineer  
**Department:** Technology / Quality Assurance  
**Industry:** Financial Technology (FinTech)  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Noida  
**Work Mode:** On-site

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Tester to join our technology team and ensure the quality, reliability, security, and performance of our FinTech products. The ideal candidate will have experience in manual and API testing, strong analytical skills, and an understanding of financial transactions, payment systems, and digital banking workflows.

The candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product managers, and other stakeholders to identify defects, validate business requirements, and deliver a seamless and secure user experience.

Key Responsibilities1. Functional and Manual Testing

* Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories.
* Prepare and execute test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test cases.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate web and mobile applications across different browsers, devices, and environments.
* Identify, document, track, and retest defects using tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
* Ensure product functionality aligns with business requirements and acceptance criteria.

2. FinTech and Financial Transaction Testing

* Test financial workflows such as fund transfers, payments, refunds, settlements, and transaction reversals.
* Validate transaction statuses, balances, fees, commissions, and applicable limits.
* Verify transaction accuracy, duplicate transaction prevention, and idempotency.
* Test failed, pending, successful, timed-out, and reversed transactions.
* Validate transaction histories, statements, reconciliation reports, and audit trails.
* Test edge cases involving insufficient balances, concurrent transactions, network failures, and partial failures.
* Verify role-based access, maker-checker approvals, and transaction authorization wherever applicable.

3. API Testing

* Perform REST API testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Validate request and response payloads, status codes, headers, authentication, and error handling.
* Test API integrations with payment gateways, banking systems, third-party service providers, and internal services.
* Validate data consistency across APIs, databases, and user interfaces.
* Test negative scenarios, boundary conditions, rate limits, retries, and timeout handling.

4. Database Testing

* Write SQL queries to validate data integrity and transaction records.
* Verify database entries against application behavior and API responses.
* Test data consistency, constraints, duplicate records, and transaction updates.
* Validate financial calculations and reconciliation data.

5. Automation Testing

* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar frameworks, where applicable.
* Automate repetitive functional and regression test cases.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with development teams.
* Analyze test execution results and troubleshoot failures.

6. Security and Performance Testing

* Support testing of authentication, authorization, session management, and access controls.
* Validate sensitive data masking and secure handling of financial information.
* Identify potential security vulnerabilities and coordinate with security teams.

7. Documentation and Collaboration

* Maintain test documentation, defect reports, execution reports, and test evidence.
* Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

What We Offer

We are relentless in our search for new and better ways of doing things. As a leader in our industry, we constantly raise the bar, take calculated risks and learn quickly from our mistakes.

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI\-enabled, people\-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long\-term value.  

Our purpose is simple \- to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values \- Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead \- we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services.
